description: Client-side script for the Customer doctype in ERPNext, handling form setup, fetches, queries, UI interactions, and custom actions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes form setup, fetches, and query configurations.

methods.name: customer_primary_address
methods.description: Fetches and sets the primary address display based on selected address.

methods.name: is_internal_customer
methods.description: Toggles requirement for 'represents_company' based on internal customer status.

methods.name: customer_primary_contact
methods.description: Clears contact details if primary contact is unset.

methods.name: loyalty_program
methods.description: Resets loyalty program tier when loyalty program is changed.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes form UI, adds custom buttons, and manages address/contact display.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Clears lead document if lead name is set.

methods.name: get_customer_group_details
methods.description: Fetches and updates customer group details.

methods.name: show_party_link_dialog
methods.description: Displays dialog to link customer with a supplier.
